title.value: Pull invoices from Gmail and organize them

introduction.value: The poster built a tool that pulls invoices from Gmail and organizes them with AI, with possible QuickBooks or Xero integration.

method.value: The poster built Invoice Agent for teams that still handle vendor invoices through email. It connects to Gmail or Outlook, detects incoming invoice emails, uses AI to extract the key details, and puts them into a searchable place; at the time of the post, the human’s role was still validating the workflow, pricing, and positioning through feedback.

outcome.value: The post gives no usage or accuracy numbers yet; it presents the product as a side project in validation. In comments, the poster says QuickBooks/Xero-style integrations and better hands-off behavior were still being worked on.

notes.value: This was still at the feedback stage, so the main catch is that the source does not provide implementation details, costs, or time savings yet.
